correctness.rationale: All 50 vertices and 75 edges are explicitly defined. Independent BFS and Floyd–Warshall distance computations give identical MMD graphs with precisely 125 outer, 50 inner and no cross edges. The five outer cliques form a complete cover of the 14 nonneighbors of u_0, bounding α_outer≤6; an independent six-set realizes it. Five disjoint 5-cycles cover all inner vertices, bounding α_inner≤10; an independent ten-set realizes it. The established and proved vertex-cover correspondence gives sdim=50−16=34. The 34-set is also directly verified to strongly resolve every one of the 1,225 unordered vertex pairs. All computations can be reconstructed from the embedded standalone programs, no extrapolation beyond n=25.

value.rationale: The 2015 paper explicitly proposes the infinite-family equality sdim(GP(4k+1,2))=5k+5 for k≥5, reaffirmed experimentally in 2017. The exact n=25 proof gives 34 instead of the expected 35 and thereby falsifies the proposal. A small geometric clique/odd-cycle certificate explains sharp optimality, rather than merely reporting a numerical result. It is a consequential, naturally motivated boundary example, without claiming a full replacement classification.
